In the past, I've been highly disgruntled by the mannerisms of both GP's and Reception staff and the shockingly long time it takes to get an appointment

However,
The tables have turned

Firstly,
Let me give credit to two GPs in particular
Dr Famoriyo & Dr Isla Young

Both of which are excellent in their field

These GPs actually listen, they show compassion and understanding
They do not rush you
They make you feel like you matter and are very thorough with their consultations, remaining calm and reassuring, in what can be a highly anxious environment
They set the bar and I hope others will follow their example

Also,

I want to say thankyou to the lovely, warm hearted, super helpful Receptionist who was on front desk this afternoon, 13th Feb
The waiting room is a gloomy place, but you definitely brighten it

Finally,
Since being able to request appointments through the online forms
You do get a response the same day and they are far more accessible

So yes,
Wellspring is winning 🏆
Long may it continue",null,[0,105]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25RNVQzTjNNRUkyUTJ4eGRIaHFWbDlKT1ROdlIwRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x1cbb7be1cb41ccd8!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnQ5T3N3MEI2Q2xxdHhqVl9JOTNvR0E%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25RNVQzTjNNRUkyUTJ4eGRIaHFWbDlKT1ROdlIwRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiFtaqdwLCTAxXgDmMBHYfKHWEQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiFtaqdwLCTAxXgDmMBHYfKHWEQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESYENBRVFBUnBDUTJrNFNVRlNTVzVEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDFZZVd0a1RWOWZSV2hDY0VoYU4yVnhaMlJWYUROamEwRTBUVUZCUVVGQlIyZG1YMEZ0VFZoNWEyUk5SMEZCYVVGQg=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNnZ1lINjRBRRAB",["0x0:0x1cbb7be1cb41ccd8",null,1739827680558633,1773160939286848,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/102446096858630054441/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Isabel Rennie","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWjOB5QbuY8a6lQP6WmvckAi-LbtcDq_iZN_RWtTlUibc096jLO=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/102446096858630054441?hl=en"],"102446096858630054441",null,16,5,null,[1,4,1],7,["Local Guide · 16 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiFtaqdwLCTAxXgDmMBHYfKHWEQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"Edited a week ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Nurses are fantastic.
